purpose: Layer 5 — run the proof portfolio over Obligations.lean cheapest-first and record an honest trust level per obligation.
summaryPrompt:
Write the proof-orchestration results as markdown.

Original Goal: {goal}

## Portfolio order used
cache → decide/simp/omega/bv_decide → SMT → bounded model checking / property testing → lemma library → agentic tactic proposal → human escalation.

## Results
A table with one row per theorem in Obligations.lean: obligation id · rung · level (`kernel-checked` | `smt-attested` | `bounded-checked` | `refuted` | `proposed` | `timeout`) · backend · ledger hypotheses used · notes.

Levels are never merged: `kernel-checked` is only allowed when a Lean run actually accepted the file without `sorry`; if no Lean toolchain was executed, the maximum level is `proposed` and this must be stated in a `## Trust caveat` section.

## Refutations
For every `refuted` row: the model-level counterexample and the concrete source-level input to replay.

## Residuals
For each rung lift attempted: the residual side conditions and their disposition (proved / assumed / refuted / runtime-checked).

## Proposed lemmas
Reusable lemmas worth adding to the library.
name: SubPlan
